# Justin He

> Portfolio and personal website of Justin He

## Blog

- [Leaving Tech to Build Something](https://www.justinhe.com/blog/creating-a-home-on-the-internet): A personal reflection on quitting a stable tech job to pursue entrepreneurial ambitions and self-directed projects.

## Projects

- [Claude Surf AI Orchestrator](https://www.justinhe.com/projects/project-claude-surf): AI-powered software development orchestrator integrating Claude with Linear and Git for autonomous task execution
- [Fantasy IDL Prediction Game](https://www.justinhe.com/projects/project-fantasy-idl): Live dance crew competition prediction game with real-time scoring and leaderboards
